title: Doctor fails instead of reporting a full-text row whose key or text is not text
outcome: Doctor fails instead of reporting a full-text row whose key or text is not text
acceptance: A full-text row in object_fts or work_catalog_fts whose key or text is NULL, an integer or a blob is reported as an orphan or a binding finding by doctor rather than aborting it with a conversion error, with a regression test for a NULL-keyed orphan in each table

completion.summary: Doctor now reports a full-text row in object_fts or work_catalog_fts whose key or text is NULL, a number, a blob or non-UTF-8 as an orphan or binding finding instead of stopping on a conversion error. Regression tests cover NULL and integer keys and NULL, blob and integer text in both tables.
